units.source_text: 先生有些感冒，懒得去客厅，让我到他的书房里去。

en.t: Sensei had a slight cold and did not feel like going to the parlor, so he had me come to his study.

units.source_text: 入冬以来少见的温暖而柔和的阳光，透过书房的玻璃门照到了书桌上。

en.t: The warm, gentle sunlight, rare since winter had set in, shone through the glass door of the study onto the desk.

units.source_text: 先生在这间光线好的房间里放了一个大火盆，放在火架上的脸盆冒着热气，以防呼吸困难。

en.t: Sensei had placed a large hibachi in this bright room, and steam rose from a basin set on the trivet to keep his breathing from becoming difficult.

units.source_text: “还不如得场大病呢，小小的感冒叫人讨厌。”

en.t: A serious illness would almost be better; a petty cold is irritating.

units.source_text: 先生苦笑了一下，望着我的脸。

en.t: Sensei gave a wry smile and looked at my face.

units.source_text: 先生从未生过什么大的病。

en.t: Sensei had never had any serious illness.

units.source_text: 听先生这么说，我直想笑。

en.t: Hearing him say that, I could not help wanting to laugh.

units.source_text: “感冒什么的我还能忍受，再重一点的病我可就受不住了。

en.t: I can put up with a cold or the like, but anything a little worse would be more than I could bear.

units.source_text: 先生也是这样吧？

en.t: It is the same for you too, isn't it, Sensei?

units.source_text: 您亲身体会一下就知道了。”

en.t: You would understand if you experienced it yourself.

units.source_text: “是吗？

en.t: Is that so?

units.source_text: 我觉得要是得病，最好得个致死的病。”

en.t: If I am going to fall ill, I think it would be best to have a fatal illness.

units.source_text: 我没有接先生的话茬，谈起了母亲的来信，向他借钱。

en.t: I did not take up Sensei's remark, but brought up my mother's letter and asked him to lend me money.

units.source_text: “你一定很犯愁吧。

en.t: You must be very troubled.

units.source_text: 这几个钱，我手头上应该有，你拿去用吧。”

en.t: I should have that much money on hand, so take it and use it.

units.source_text: 先生叫来夫人，让她把钱如数拿给我。

en.t: Sensei called his wife and had her bring me the full amount of money.

units.source_text: 夫人去了里屋，从橱柜抽屉里取来钱，整齐地放在一张白纸上，说：“你很担心吧？”

en.t: His wife went to the back room, took the money from a cabinet drawer, placed it neatly on a sheet of white paper, and said, You must be worried.

units.source_text: “是晕倒过好几次吗？”

en.t: Has he fainted several times?

units.source_text: 先生问我。

en.t: Sensei asked me.

units.source_text: “信上什么也没提。

en.t: The letter did not mention anything.

units.source_text: 这种病经常会摔倒吗？”

en.t: Does this illness often make a person collapse?

units.source_text: “是啊。”

en.t: Yes, it does.

units.source_text: 这时我才知道夫人的母亲，也是患了跟我父亲相同的病去世的。

en.t: Only then did I learn that Sensei's wife's mother had also died of the same illness as my father.

units.source_text: “反正是很难好了吧。”

en.t: In any case, it will be very hard for him to recover, won't it?

units.source_text: 我说。

en.t: I said.

units.source_text: “是啊。

en.t: Yes.

units.source_text: 我倒是真希望能代替他呢。

en.t: I truly wish I could take his place.

units.source_text: 他呕吐吗？”

en.t: Does he vomit?
